title: Docking Layout Default Restore

oracle.positive: Reset custom layout recreates Matrix-oriented baseline positions
oracle.negative: Unknown layout version does not crash, resets to default

reviewer.role: project owner (human reviewer) running the app on Windows

checks_run: RED: cargo test -p om9-app --test dock_layout_default -> 4 passed; 3 failed (N2 named no version, N9 had no home repair, one fixture expectation was wrong)
GREEN: cargo test -p om9-app --test dock_layout_default -> 7 passed; 0 failed
cargo test -p om9-app --lib: 83 passed; cargo test --workspace: every group ok; cargo check --workspace --all-targets: exit 0
cargo fmt --check: exit 0; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: exit 0
real windows: tools/validate_m01_l3_002_ui_matrix.py --mode all -> 14/14 PASS; tools/validate_m01_l3_003_panels.py -> 7/7 PASS (no regression from the layout parse change)
code_change: dock_layout.rs::from_json now reads the declared schema_version from the raw document before the typed parse, so a document from another version is refused by name ('layout version N is not supported; restored the Matrix default') instead of being reported as an unreadable document. Found by fixture N2.
dock_layout.rs::normalize now repairs a stored home that cannot exist in its column (index past the end) to the documented position with a diagnostic. Found by fixture N9.
dock_layout.rs::from_bytes(bytes) added: the same parse with the built-in limits, so tests and tools reach the version gate without owning a path.

manual_reviewer_checklist.scope_note: Machine proof covers the model and the load path; only the owner can confirm the live commands and messages in a real window.

items.step: Move, collapse, dock and float a few menus any way you like, then run View ▸ Matrix Menus ▸ Reset Menus.
items.machine_proven: reset_to_default is the documented baseline byte for byte, from every customisation kind (D1, D2); an active drag is cancelled.
items.human_must_verify: Every menu is back in the documented order and size, nothing floats, the right column is hidden again, and the status line reads 'Menus reset to the Matrix default'.

items.step: Drag the left rail wider (about 420), then Reset Menus.
items.machine_proven: the baseline size of every panel is the documented number and reset restores it (D1).
items.human_must_verify: The rail returns to its documented width and the icons go back to their documented edge.

items.step: Arrange the menus, run Set as Default, change the arrangement again, then Reload Menus. Repeat in a session that has never run Set as Default.
items.machine_proven: reload without a store is the factory default (D4) with the status 'Menus reloaded from the factory default'; a kept configuration reloads without a schema diagnostic.
items.human_must_verify: Reload brings back the configuration you kept, and a session without one says it used the factory default.

items.step: Put a layout file with schema_version 1 at the layout path and start the app (see the OM9-L3-01-01-005 item for the exact path once it is recorded).
items.machine_proven: N1/N2/N3/N6: any other version returns the baseline, names the version in the diagnostic, and never half-applies the document.
items.human_must_verify: The app starts with the Matrix default, the status/history names the refused version, and nothing from the old file leaks in.

items.step: Put a layout file with broken bytes, and one with an impossible stored home, at the layout path and start the app.
items.machine_proven: N4/N5/N7: unreadable, empty or oversized bytes are refused; N9: an impossible home is repaired to the documented position with a diagnostic.
items.human_must_verify: The app starts with the baseline, reports the ignored layout or the repaired home, and never crashes or hangs.
